title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: Demo synopsis: Introduces the Transformer, a neural network architecture based on attention for sequence modeling and machine translation, without recurrent or convolutional layers.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract: Demo synopsis: Pretrains bidirectional Transformer representations using masked language modeling. Fine-tuning supports natural language processing tasks including question answering and inference.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
abstract: Demo synopsis: Combines dense document retrieval with a sequence-to-sequence language model for knowledge-intensive natural language processing and question answering.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
abstract: Demo synopsis: Studies GPT-3, a large autoregressive language model, and evaluates few-shot learning through examples supplied in the input context.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
abstract: Demo synopsis: Efficiently adapts pretrained language models by learning low-rank weight updates while keeping original model parameters frozen.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
abstract: Demo synopsis: Applies a Transformer to sequences of image patches for computer vision image classification, studying large-scale pretraining.
